title: Is it allowed to keep both [H]dairy[/H] and [P]parve[/P] in the same refrigerator?
options: On shelves on different sides, as long as there is a chart on the fridge and you arrange accordingly.

wrongMsg: ❌ Incorrect. It is allowed only with clear separation and a fixed arrangement that prevents drips/contact.
